description: Regional physical-resource signals that condition local computational capacity.

geography.meaning: state, province, territory, or equivalent first-order administrative region

water.principle: water is a physical constraint on regional compute capacity, not merely descriptive metadata

derived.compute_feasibility: derived regional projection; never treated as a raw observation
derived.resource_pressure: derived from permission-eligible observations and current regional conditions
derived.locality_rule: regional signals may condition local context without exporting underlying sensitive records
